title: Kirk Cousins: Klint Kubiak ran the most productive OTAs I've ever been a part of

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Kirk Cousins: Klint Kubiak ran the most productive OTAs I've ever been a part of
sources.description: "He created a sense of urgency from Day One, all the way through the 10-week program, and I thought we got a lot of work done," Cousins said of Kubiak.
